messages:
alex: Heads-up — new intake: open-source 'citrine-12b' popped up as a good candidate. Need a short model-gate checklist + prompt/chat templates that handle tool-calling & structured outputs. Priorities: 1) quality regressions vs current 13B baseline, 2) quantization experiments (int8/int4), 3) onboarding runbook for API/chat integration. Who can pick this up?

maya: I can draft the priority rubric and an initial checklist. Quick rubric idea: severity x likelihood for regressions, customer-facing use-case priority, latency/cost impact estimate. Will sketch a checklist: onboarding metadata -> smoke evals -> quant experiments -> integration templates -> rollout plan.

chris: I can handle prompt/chat templates and tooling examples. Couple of things I want to lock down: the chat system message, canonical tool schema for function-calling, and a minimal JSON schema for structured outputs. Sample skeleton I propose:

```
System: "You are a helpful assistant that must return JSON matching the schema unless performing a tool call. Keep answers concise."
User: "<user prompt here>"
Assistant (tools): call a tool when needed with: {
  "name": "search_knowledge_base",
  "arguments": {"query": "...", "top_k": 3}
}
```

And an example function schema (send to models that support function-calling):

```
{
  "name": "lookup_customer",
  "description": "Return customer record by id",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "customer_id": {"type": "string"}
    },
    "required": ["customer_id"]
  }
}
```

For structured answers when not calling a tool, require a top-level `response` object and `metadata` field. Example: {"response": {"answer": "..."}, "metadata": {"confidence": 0.92}}. Keep max_tokens conservative (e.g., 256) for cheap fast replies in CI.

sophia: For quant experiments: start with int8 on same tokenization and run the following: 1) full eval suite (prompt-holdout + safety checks) -> measure exact-match/EM, chrF/ROUGE-lite, and instruction-following score; 2) latency p50/p95 and memory high-water on our standard 2-gpu config; 3) KV cache regression tests (ensure cache warm-up isn't changing outputs). Notes: int4 often requires per-layer remapping and has higher failure variance; flag any >1.5% EM drop compared to float16 as blocker. Also capture generation divergence: sample-seed diffs on 50 deterministic prompts.

marco: Add rollout gating — must pass these gates before a canary: (A) no more than 2% relative drop on prioritized benchmark set, (B) no PII hallucination increase, (C) latency P95 within 1.3x of baseline or clear cost offset, (D) quantized rollout must include an automatic fallback to float16 model if response_quality_score < threshold. Also require a short migration playbook for Dedicated/Private customers (pin old model, expose opt-in flags).

chris: Integration checklist for API folks (short):
- model entry: name, version, tokenizer, license, source link, trained-vocab size
- canonical chat templates (system/user/assistant) saved in model metadata
- function schema examples (if tools expected) in model card
- recommended runtime params: max_tokens, stop sequences, temperature, top_p, streaming flag
- structured-output schema (JSON Schema) with validation hook in client SDKs

Example minimal chat template to include in model card:
```
System: "You are a concise domain expert for product X. Always return JSON matching `output_schema` unless using a tool."
User: "Summarize findings for: <context>"
```

Also: add a tiny prompt lint step in CI that checks for ambiguous system messages and missing stop sequences.

alex: @chris please own the model-card templates. @maya own the prioritization rubric and intake PR. @sophia run the quant experiments (int8, int4 baseline) and post artifacts (diff logs, seed samples). @marco draft the rollout gating + playbook. I'll set a deadline EOD next Wed and a quick sync Friday.

sophia: One more data point on eval harness: include a small hard-coded regression set of 200 prompts (mix of instruction-following, code, and factual QA). Compute the instruction-following pass rate and a generative-similarity score (embedding cosine to baseline answer). If cosine drops >0.03 we flag for manual inspection.

maya: I'll create a tiny scoring spreadsheet: columns = metric, baseline, candidate, delta, weight, weighted_score. Will surface top 3 failure cases for triage.

deploy-bot: CI: started citrine-12b int8 smoke tests -> logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1719954321/citrine-int8-smoke (will post artifacts when done) :rocket:

marco: For documentation: final model-card should include: contact owner, known limitations, quantization notes (which layers were remapped), recommended batch sizes, and a short example curl/SDK snippet showing function-call usage and structured output validation. Keep it copy-paste ready.

alex: Great — thanks all. We'll reconvene after the CI artifacts. If anyone hits a blocker on kernel selection or failsafe fallback, ping #eng-runtime as well. :thumbsup:
